sections.opening_bias: Soft open with yields steady — watch SPY 548 and the semis tape into the open. Bias is cautiously constructive while QQQ holds overnight gains.
sections.session_setup_html:
Futures are pointing to a quiet open after a constructive Asia session. SPY is hovering near its overnight pivot, and breadth in futures looks constructive rather than euphoric.

The main tell is whether semis can extend without a sharp yield spike. If the 10-year stays contained, the path of least resistance is a grind higher into the midmorning data.
sections.key_level_note: SPY 545 is the line for the morning. Lose it on volume and the open strength is a fade; hold it through JOLTS and the door stays open for a push toward 550.
sections.todays_watch_html: Focus the first hour on whether QQQ can hold above overnight support while energy stays soft. A clean hold with rising semis is the constructive tell; a failed reclaim of SPY 548 with rising VIX is the risk-off tell.
sections.biggest_risk: A hot JOLTS print that lifts yields and knocks rate-sensitive tech lower would flip a soft open into a failed rally. There is little room for a simultaneous squeeze in yields and a break of SPY 545.
